fields.name: Anton Ryzhikov
fields.title: Engineering Manager
fields.whoAmI: I'm the engineering leader with 10+ years of experience in software development and 5+ years in engineering management and technical leadership. Expertizing in designing, building, scaling and maintaining product-oriented software for global markets, accountable for systems handling up to 40% of company revenue. I successfully led cross-functional engineering teams of up to 18 members in total, driving technical vision, architectural evolution, and operational excellence. I got experience in transforming complex technical challenges into working and scalable solutions, e.g. launching self-service kiosks serving millions of monthly orders or transforming point-of-sale solutions to be extendable by 3rd party providers around the world. I'm also fond of establishing sustainable engineering practices like feature ownership, ADRs, maturity models, toil and incident management, with the emphasis on trust, team autonomy and outcome-driven delivery.

companies.name: Snoonu
companies.description: We provide Qatari-founded superapp service featuring food delivery, marketplace, taxi and other verticals operating in 4 countries in the Middle East.
companies.techStack: .NET, RabbitMQ, MassTransit, React, Typescript, Python, LangChain, LangGraph, MongoDB, AWS Bedrock, Salesforce

roles.description:
- Leading 3 teams driven to enhance customer agent experience and decrease mean time to resolve for the complains by creating end-to-end widgets to embed to Salesforce Service cloud, leveraging automation to launch AI-assisted SOP-driven workflows, and setting up data and action layers, for both humans and AI.
 - Created and demostrated the product vision and roadmap for all teams. Pivoted the product direction to widgets instead of creating competing products. Led and finalized several architecture reviews to set up the services foundation, leveraging Langchain-based SOP handling, widgets frontend monorepo and event-driven data snapshot service.
- Successfully launched brand new service from scratch, as well as maintaining several legacy/low-maintained products by addressing tech debt and reliability issues.

companies.name: Dodo Brands
companies.description: We create global food francizes to make our clients happy by opening 1500+ pizza shops in 25+ countries and over 200 coffee shops in 3 countries.
companies.techStack: C#, React, Typescript, Electron, MySQL, RabbitMQ, Kafka, Kubernetes, Azure, Yandex Cloud

roles.description:
Led 3 sub-teams of up to 18 members overall, responsible for Point of Sale systems across 23 countries to ensure reliable in-person payment processing and fiscalization compliance.
 - Oversaw the design and implementation of the multi-platform solution pluginizing external payment and fiscalization connectors to avoid extra development needed to start purchasing in-place in new countries and leveraging Android kiosks to reduce device CapEx by up to 12% when opening new stores.
 - Set up the foundation for quick product data-driven discovery experiments to let business check new hypothesis, such as new checkout flow or new payment methods promotions.
 - Responsible for critical-path services (6 backends, over 7 microfrontends), including its technical projects, such as migration from legacy monolith, postmortem resolutions and keeping up with the SLOs.
 - Focused on team growth, toil and technical debt reduction while establishing sustainable delivery processes with clear ownership and incident management.

- Founded and led development of a self-service kiosk platform deployed across 18 countries on 2000+ units, integrated with 25 payment providers (8 proprietary), with own settings, auth and installation process, dynamic menu and promo screens, etc.
 - Delivered a unified web-based experience across desktop and mobile, supporting 2M monthly orders and increasing average check by 12%.
 - Ensured seamless integration for hardware parts of the kiosk using iOS and Electron application (payments, receipts, secure mode) to provide secure and quick way to install and update the shell that sets it up together.
 - Grew team size by 100%.
 - Set up and justified the new monolithic architecture for Point of Sale backend ecosystem, improving time-to-release and development experience.

- Sustained and evolved a distributed POS system across 15 countries, managing backend, frontend, and Electron-based desktop services, such as setting up electronic receipts to reduce paper costs or cashier goals prototype to increase in-person average bills.
 - Drove technical strategy, prioritized technical backlog, identified technical debt, and led migration from monolith to domain services.
 - Participated in full feature lifecycle, from refinement to operational support, with the emphasis on non-functional requirements and system reliability.

- Contributed to a full-stack autonomous team within a larger LESS structure, implementing features for cashier interfaces, monolith decoupling, and new countries support.
 - Participated in monitoring, incident response, postmortems, and reliability enhancements (e.g. caching strategies, database optimizations).
 - Facilitated team meetings and contributed to local engineering communities.

companies.name: Align Technology
companies.description: We help people to scan their teeth and set up the dental treatment plan to fix their bite by creating custom aligners.
companies.techStack: C#, Angular, Typescript, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, AWS

roles.description:
- Led a cross-regional web team focused on infrastructure and customer-facing features for the iTero scanner platform, e.g. guided way to ease the client 'happy path' from scanning to setting up treatment simumation within minutes, available from scanner and web.
 - Contributed to refactoring legacy components, enhancing client logging/monitoring, and building cloud-native services like desktop notifications for lab assistants.
 - Participated in hiring, technical architecture discussions, DevOps assistance and internal initiatives.

- Migrated monolithic applications to microservices on AWS, enabling regional data synchronization with 3D scanners and lab software.
- Developed APIs to obtain 3D models from web, maintained performance by moving from stored procedures, and integrated with internal data hubs using Siren client.
- Supported hiring and onboarding of new engineers.

- Developed the MyAlignTech platform for 3D dental case tracking, billing, subscriptions and scanner management as a part of the distributed Moscow-Tel Aviv team.
 - Worked on metadata synchronization, performance optimization under increasing load, and embedded functionality in iTero scanners (embedded client, WCF-based communication layer, emulator for testing).

companies.name: Transaero Aviation Training Center
companies.description: We help cabin attendants, pilots and other personnel attend and pass tracked interactive courses in our own hand-written learning management system.

 - Built a system for tracking English test results and scheduling between teachers and airline employees using ASP.NET MVC, jQuery, and SQL Server 2012.
